onec.title: 1C
onec.simText: A simulator with demo invoices stands in for 1C right now. Enter the database address and a service user to read your own 1C (for example 1C:Fresh).
onec.liveText: Your 1C database is connected. Sync reads posted invoices, contracts, payments and unexecuted payment orders from it; the service cannot write anything to 1C.
onec.managerOnly: Only the company owner can see and change the 1C address and password.
onec.urlHint: The application address from your browser, without the language code and without /odata. https only.
onec.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown after saving.
onec.passwordKept: Password is saved. Leave empty to keep it (after changing the address you must enter it again).
onec.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect 1C? The address and password will be deleted; events already loaded from 1C stay.
onec.keyMissing: The server has no INTEGRATIONS_KEY encryption key for passwords. The server administrator creates it during installation (see docs/integrator.md); then the password can be saved.
onec.how1: In 1C open "Administration → Data synchronization → Standard OData interface settings".
onec.how2: On the "Authorization" tab create a separate service user with read-only access.
onec.how3: On the "Composition" tab tick these objects:
onec.how4: Take the address from your browser's address bar while your database is open, without the language code at the end, for example https://msk1.1cfresh.com/a/ea/4269703.
onec.how5: Enter the address, login and password above, press "Check connection", then "Save".
onec.howSecurity: The address must be public and use https: the service does not connect to closed or internal networks. No more than 10 checks per minute.
onec.checkMore: That is not all: only the first records are counted.
onec.optionalMissing: Optional objects are not published (some payment details will be incomplete without them): {{names}}.

assistant.description: AI CFO: cash, taxes, 1C, risks, strategies and app guidance. Chats are saved.
assistant.welcome: Hello! I am the AI CFO: I explain cash flow, taxes, 1C, risks and how to use the app in plain words, and take numbers from the company data. I may ask a clarifying question. What I may do — view, propose or add payments myself — is set by the owner in Settings → AI advisor.

replies.checkRisk: • Gap risk {{probPercent}}: consider postponing payments or speeding up receipts.

{{itemsLines}}

account.lastMethodNote: The only sign-in method cannot be removed: add another one first.

apiTokens.title: API access
apiTokens.subtitle: A token gives external systems (1C, BI, scripts) access to your company data. No company id is needed: the token identifies the company.
apiTokens.name: Token name
apiTokens.createdText: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
apiTokens.endpoints: Available: GET /api/ext/v1/company, forecast, transactions, expected-events, plan-fact; POST forecast and expected-events.
apiTokens.rights: Token permissions = permissions of your role: {{role}}.
apiTokens.rightsWrite: The token can read and write data (read and write).
apiTokens.rightsRead: The token can only read data (GET requests). If your role changes, token permissions change immediately.

telegram.title: Notification schedule (Telegram and email)
telegram.subtitle: The bot sends a cash-gap alert a week ahead, a weekly risk report, and weekly and monthly summaries with a plan. You mark goal results in the bot — they drive the next plan.
telegram.notConfigured: The bot is not configured: the administrator has not set a Telegram bot token.
telegram.connectHint: The link is valid for 15 minutes and works once.
telegram.gapHint: Reminders also arrive 3 days and 1 day before while the risk remains.
telegram.missedHint: A client payment did not arrive or a planned debit did not go through 5 days after the expected date. One message per payment; checked every 3 hours from 8 to 21.
telegram.advisorOn: Hermes advisor is connected: advice arrives in reports.
telegram.advisorOff: Hermes advisor is not connected: reports use rules.
telegram.aiConsent: Hermes advisor: advice in reports and questions in the bot
telegram.aiConsentHint: Allows sending summary company statistics (amounts, dates, payment names) to the cloud model. Without consent nothing is sent. Ask the bot with /ask or plain text in a private chat.

goals.title: Weekly goals
goals.description: Agile cycle: rate last week's goals — the result shapes the next plan. You can do the same with buttons in the Telegram bot.
goals.empty: No goals yet: they are created with the weekly bot report.
goals.noPrevious: There was no previous week yet.
goals.historyEmpty: History appears after the first rated week.
goals.rateHint: Rate the goals — the plan updates automatically.
goals.advisorOn: Hermes advisor is connected: advice arrives in reports.
goals.advisorOff: Hermes advisor is not connected: reports use rules.

team.title: Team and policies
team.subtitle: The administrator sets departments, which reports they get, and who can rate goals. Members appear when they write to the bot in a chat.
team.noDepartments: No departments: every chat gets every report.
team.name: Department name
team.inviteBanner: You opened a team invitation. Sign in or register, then you can accept it. The company name at registration is not used if you join someone else's.
team.inviteText: You were invited to a company. After accepting you will work with its data in the assigned role. Your own company is kept and comes back if you leave the team.

web.inviteHint: Valid for 7 days and works once. Send it to the person: they need to sign in or register and accept the invitation.
web.leaveText: You work in another company as «{{role}}». After leaving you return to your own company.
web.inviteEmailHint: If set, the invitation is e-mailed and only a user with this e-mail can accept it.
web.emailSent: The invitation e-mail was sent. You can still share the link by hand.
web.emailNotSent: The e-mail was not sent: mail is not configured or the address was rejected. Share the link by hand.
web.emailLimited: The e-mail limit is reached (50 per hour per company). Share the link by hand.
web.inviteSubtitle: A one-time link with a role (valid 7 days). With an email the invitation is sent to it and only that address can accept. Only the owner invites administrators.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.description: Who changed what in the company: team, goals, Telegram, imports. Visible to the owner and admins.

operator.title: Operator panel
operator.description: Companies registered on the platform: statistics and blocking. The contents of company data are not available.
operator.privacy: The operator sees only registration details and aggregates. Customers' transactions and payments are not shown here.

login.title: Operator sign-in
login.subtitle: Staff sign-in for the platform team.

companies.title: Companies
companies.subtitle: Click a name to open the company card.

ban.title: Block “{{name}}”?
ban.effect: All users of the company and their API tokens will lose access and active sessions will be ended. The company's data is kept.
ban.reasonHint: Company users will see it. Up to {{max}} characters.

unban.title: Unblock “{{name}}”?
unban.effect: The company's users will be able to sign in and use API tokens again.

demo.title: Demo: a week has passed
demo.today: Demo "today": {{date}}. The next operations are still "in the future".
demo.undone_one: Rolled back {{count}} operation for {{from}} – {{to}}. The forecast was recomputed.
demo.undone_other: Rolled back {{count}} operations for {{from}} – {{to}}. The forecast was recomputed.
demo.unavailable: The demo feed is unavailable right now.
demo.done_one: Added {{count}} operation for {{from}} – {{to}}. The forecast was recalculated.
demo.done_other: Added {{count}} operations for {{from}} – {{to}}. The forecast was recalculated.
demo.vsFactInBand: Previous forecast for {{date}}: {{predicted}}, actual {{actual}} — inside the P10–P90 band.
demo.vsFactOutBand: Previous forecast for {{date}}: {{predicted}}, actual {{actual}} — outside the P10–P90 band.

role.editorHint: Sees all data and can change it: import, payments, categories, calendar, sync.
role.viewerHint: View-only access to data and calculations.
role.adminHint: Manages the team, the company name and notification settings; sees the activity log and edits data. Only the owner assigns administrators.

perms.denied: Not enough rights: this action needs the Analyst role or higher
perms.directorOnly: Only the owner can change this
perms.importDenied: Not enough rights: statement import is available to Owner, Administrator and Analyst.
perms.readOnlyBanner: You have read-only access: company data cannot be changed.
perms.adminOnly: The owner and administrators can change this

password.title: Change your password
password.textForced: You were given a temporary password. Set your own before continuing.
password.textOptional: The director set this password. We recommend changing it to your own; you can do it later.

credentials.title: Set the director email and password
credentials.text: You signed in with an e-signature. A company director must have a password: you cannot continue without it. The signature still works for signing in.

banned.title: The company has been blocked by the operator
banned.text: Access to the data of "{{company}}" is suspended for all employees.
banned.contact: If you think this is a mistake, contact the platform operator.

members.title: Employees
members.subtitleManage: Add staff, set roles, reset passwords and transfer ownership. Invite links are in the block below.
members.subtitleView: Company staff. The owner and administrators manage them.
members.generateHint: The password is shown once, right after adding. The employee must change it at first sign-in.
members.manualHint: 8 to 128 characters. The employee can change it at first sign-in.
members.deleteText: {{email}} will lose access, and their sessions and API tokens will be revoked. This cannot be undone.
members.createdText: If the email invitation does not arrive, give the password to {{email}} yourself. They must change it at first sign-in.
members.resetDoneText: The email with a link could not be sent, so here is a new password for {{email}}. All their sessions are closed; they must change the password at sign-in.
members.onceTitle: The password is shown only once
members.onceText: After you close this window the password cannot be shown again: copy it now. If you lose it, reset the password again.
members.rolesNote: The owner can do everything and transfers ownership. Administrator: team, company name, notification settings, activity log and data; only the owner assigns administrators. Analyst: read and change data. Observer: view only.
members.transferText: {{email}} becomes the owner and you become an administrator. Only the new owner can give ownership back.
members.inviteMailedText: An email with a link was sent to {{email}}: the employee will set their own password. The link is valid for 72 hours.
members.resetMailedText: The employee's sessions are closed. An email with a link to set a new password was sent to {{email}} (valid for 72 hours).

forgot.title: Password recovery
forgot.text: Enter the email you sign in with. We will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentText: If {{email}} is registered, an email with a link has been sent to it. The link is valid for 1 hour.
forgot.noLetter: No email? Check the spam folder or request a new link in a minute. The company owner or an administrator can also reset an employee's password.

reset.title: New password
reset.text: Choose a new password. After saving, all open sessions are closed; sign in again.
reset.inviteText: You have been invited to a company. Choose a password to sign in with your email.
reset.doneText: Sign in with the new password. Your email is now confirmed.
reset.expiredText: The link has already been used or has expired (it is valid for 1 hour). Request a new one on the sign-in screen: "Forgot password?".
reset.expiredInvite: The link has already been used or has expired. Ask the company owner or an administrator to send the invitation again or reset your password.

verify.title: Email confirmation
verify.doneText: Cash gap alerts and reports can now come to this address. Emails can be set up in Settings.
verify.expiredText: The link has already been used or has expired (it is valid for 24 hours). Sign in and click "Send the email again" in the top bar.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.doneText: Alerts and reports will no longer be emailed. Sign-in emails (password recovery) still arrive. You can turn mailings back on in Settings.
unsubscribe.expiredText: The link is invalid. Emails can be managed in Settings → Email notifications.

banner.text: Confirm your email {{email}}: until it is confirmed, alerts and reports are not emailed.
banner.sent: An email has been sent to {{email}}. Follow the link in it.

settings.title: Email notifications
settings.subtitle: What comes to your own inbox. Every employee has their own settings.
settings.lockedText: Follow the link from the email sent after registration. Mailings are off until the email is confirmed.
settings.alertsHint: A warning 7, 3 and 1 day before a possible gap, an email when the risk goes down, and missed plan-fact payments.
settings.reportsHint: Risk report, weekly and monthly results with a chart; the monthly one comes with an Excel file.
settings.schedule: When reports arrive and the alert probability threshold are set by the owner or an administrator in "Notification schedule".
settings.testSent: A test email has been sent to {{email}}.

datasetEval.title: Control dataset evaluation
datasetEval.subtitle: Every company of all_operations.csv: rolling-origin backtest, balance and gap metrics
datasetEval.hint: Choose the dataset file (optionally with companies.csv). For every company the model sees only the past at each check date, forecasts 30 days and is compared with the actual balance. Nothing is saved to the company.
datasetEval.notDataset: Not a dataset file: a company_id column with several companies is required
datasetEval.summary: Companies: {{companies}}, evaluated (5+ months of history): {{evaluated}}, check points: {{origins}}.
datasetEval.matrix: Confusion matrix: gap within 30 days, alarm at P ≥ 50%
datasetEval.calibration: Mean predicted probability {{p}} vs actual gap rate {{rate}}.
datasetEval.balance: Balance forecast error (P50 vs actual), mean over companies
datasetEval.nmae: NMAE — MAE as % of the company median weekly turnover.
